verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official desktop app, Kimi Code Desktop, that opens local project folders and lets the agent read code, edit files and run commands. That covers only the 'official desktop app' part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows OS-level or global shortcuts, or any ability to see or capture what is on the user's screen. missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, screen-content access or screen capture, a general-purpose (non-coding) desktop assistant, independent or hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: Open a local project folder in Kimi Code Desktop and let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands, and verify results through conversation.
